title: Huntik Go
summary:
Huntik Go is the opening theme song for Huntik: Secrets & Seekers and is heard at the start of every episode in both seasons of the show. Due to the international broadcast of the series, several different language dubs of the song exist, with the English version being performed by Jeff Washburn. The English version of the song was combined with the Heroes and Titans ending theme and released commercially as a single track on the 13th August 2010.

The song was available for streaming on Spotify for a long time, but eventually removed.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*In the [[Season 2]] opening, the bass of the song is increased.
*In the episode "[[The Power of Umbra]]", [[Teeg]] is heard listening to the song on his iPod whilst cooking.
*The instrumental is used as incidental music for the first and only time in the episode "[[Lok's Leadership]]", when [[Dante]] and [[Caliban]] train before [[Master Storm]].
*The English voice actress for [[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Rebecca Soler]], used to play the song in her iPod as a workout song. {{Extsource|1=https://youtu.be/nfHaM0aiGqc?t=921|2=YouTube}}
*The song's performer in the Portuguese dub is also the voice actor for [[Lok Lambert]] in that same dub

== Trivia ==
*In the Season 2 opening, the bass of the song is increased.
*In the episode "The Power of Umbra", Teeg is heard listening to the song on his iPod whilst cooking.
*The instrumental is used as incidental music for the first and only time in the episode "Lok's Leadership", when Dante and Caliban train before Master Storm.
*The English voice actress for Sophie Casterwill, Rebecca Soler, used to play the song in her iPod as a workout song. 
*The song's performer in the Portuguese dub is also the voice actor for Lok Lambert in that same dub
